== Pucumir Thryss relationship correction ==
Both [[Endor Commando Team]] and [[Endor Commando Team (Errata)]] print a uniqueness bullet before the title. Pucumir Thryss requires a non-unique Rebel, so the unsupported Pucumir entry was removed from both articles. The pinned Players Committee data lists Pucumir under the current Endor Commando Team record's <code>pulledBy</code>, but this conflicts with Pucumir's printed targeting requirement.<ref>Players Committee, [https://raw.githubusercontent.com/swccgpc/swccg-card-json/d4e661ec735dcb111266fbda98704f2181e1cfab/Light.json complete pinned primary card data], records <code>203_5</code> (Endor Commando Team) and <code>6_33</code> (Pucumir Thryss).</ref> The General Crix Madine relation is retained: both Endor faces are scouts of ability 1, and Madine takes a scout of ability less than 3.<ref>Players Committee, [https://raw.githubusercontent.com/swccgpc/swccg-card-json/d4e661ec735dcb111266fbda98704f2181e1cfab/Light.json complete pinned primary card data], record <code>8_14</code> (General Crix Madine); [[:File:V3-L-endorcommandoteam-2018-07-08.gif|original Endor face]] and [[:File:V3-L-endorcommandoteam.gif|later Endor face]].</ref>
